candidates.violated_requirement: When in state s4 with data=0, the state machine should transition to s5 to continue matching the sequence 011100, but instead transitions to sf5 due to the swapped targets. This causes a false not_match output when the full sequence is actually present.
candidates.spec_basis: The module must detect the sequence 011100 from the input signal data. If the sequence is detected, match should assert; otherwise not_match should assert.
